$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for validation and autocomplete
$schema.markdownDescription: JSON Schema URL for validation and autocomplete

json.description: Output in JSON format (shorthand for --format json)
json.markdownDescription: Output in JSON format (shorthand for --format json)

format.description: Output format: table, json, tree, or tree-table. Shorthands --json (=-f json) and --tree (=-f tree) override the default when --format is unset.
format.markdownDescription: Output format: table, json, tree, or tree-table. Shorthands --json (=-f json) and --tree (=-f tree) override the default when --format is unset.

tree.description: Output in hierarchical tree view (shorthand for --format tree)
tree.markdownDescription: Output in hierarchical tree view (shorthand for --format tree)

group.description: Group/bucket selector, comma-separated. A time-bucket (daily|weekly|monthly|session) selects the data loader and occupies the time nesting slot at its position; the rest are nesting dims: project,provider,agent,reseller,region,plan,model. Omitting a bucket loads all records with no time aggregation. Default: daily (→ time,model). Example: --group agent,reseller,region,plan,model,weekly
group.markdownDescription: Group/bucket selector, comma-separated. A time-bucket (daily|weekly|monthly|session) selects the data loader and occupies the time nesting slot at its position; the rest are nesting dims: project,provider,agent,reseller,region,plan,model. Omitting a bucket loads all records with no time aggregation. Default: daily (→ time,model). Example: --group agent,reseller,region,plan,model,weekly

wrap.description: Tree view: wrap each row after the `out` column onto a second line (cache_create / cache_read / billing / stats). Reduces horizontal width.
wrap.markdownDescription: Tree view: wrap each row after the `out` column onto a second line (cache_create / cache_read / billing / stats). Reduces horizontal width.

mode.description: Cost calculation mode: auto (use costUSD if exists, otherwise calculate), calculate (always calculate), display (always use costUSD)
mode.markdownDescription: Cost calculation mode: auto (use costUSD if exists, otherwise calculate), calculate (always calculate), display (always use costUSD)

debug.description: Show pricing mismatch information for debugging
debug.markdownDescription: Show pricing mismatch information for debugging

debugSamples.description: Number of sample discrepancies to show in debug output (default: 5)
debugSamples.markdownDescription: Number of sample discrepancies to show in debug output (default: 5)

order.description: Sort order: desc (newest first) or asc (oldest first)
order.markdownDescription: Sort order: desc (newest first) or asc (oldest first)

color.description: Enable colored output (default: auto). FORCE_COLOR=1 has the same effect.
color.markdownDescription: Enable colored output (default: auto). FORCE_COLOR=1 has the same effect.

noColor.description: Disable colored output (default: auto). NO_COLOR=1 has the same effect.
noColor.markdownDescription: Disable colored output (default: auto). NO_COLOR=1 has the same effect.

timezone.markdownDescription: Timezone for date grouping (e.g., UTC, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo). Default: system timezone

locale.description: Locale for date/time formatting (e.g., en-US, ja-JP, de-DE)
locale.markdownDescription: Locale for date/time formatting (e.g., en-US, ja-JP, de-DE)

jq.markdownDescription: Process JSON output with jq command (requires jq binary, implies --json)

compact.markdownDescription: Force compact mode for narrow displays (better for screenshots)

statsCurrency.markdownDescription: Statistics currency (ISO 4217) to project usage costs into, e.g. "CNY". Default: USD.

paymentCurrency.markdownDescription: Payment currency (ISO 4217) for the payable column, e.g. "CNY". Default: USD.

costColumns.description: Comma-separated cost columns to show: billing,payable,stats. Default: billing.
costColumns.markdownDescription: Comma-separated cost columns to show: billing,payable,stats. Default: billing.

pricingPath.markdownDescription: Path to the per-platform user pricing overrides (zccusage-pricing.json).
